system.description: You married beneath your station — a countess to a knight, a duke to a baron's daughter — and have lost social standing as a result. Your own class treats you with disrespect or outright snubs you, while your spouse is ignored or treated rudely by his own peers, unsure how to behave toward either of you. All Social rolls made while dealing with your former peers suffer a +2 difficulty. Your marriage may be a genuinely happy one, but you have paid dearly for it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
